items.title: GameStop stock sinks to lowest level since August 2024
items.summary: GameStop stock sank on Monday as the company announced plans for a private exchange of $1.4 billion of its debt for common stock.

items.title: Why GameStop Stock Just Wiped Out All Its 2026 Gains
items.summary: GameStop  said it would swap $1.4 billion worth of debt for stock on Monday, sending the videogame retailer’s shares tumbling.  The one-time meme stock sank 13% to $18.92 on Monday, wiping out all of its gains for the year and heading for its worst daily percentage decline in more than a year, according to Dow Jones Market Data.  The  was 1.4% higher after President Donald Trump said the U.S. would restart talks with Iran.

items.title: Wells Fargo bearish on eBay, highlights rising U.S. competition from Vinted
items.summary: Investing.com -- Wells Fargo downgraded eBay to Underweight from Equal Weight in a note to clients on Monday, citing escalating U.S. competitive intensity that it expects to drive negative earnings revisions.
